meta.subtitle: 7+ Years | Tabular ML → Computer Vision → LLM Application → Generative AI

summary: I find problems no one has defined yet and turn them into products that deliver business results.

For seven years, I have led AI products and teams across fintech AutoML, medical AI, commerce AIaaS, and generative AI video. I translate between technology, markets, and organizations, making the case with working demos rather than words. I align product teams with the company's vision and OKRs and stay accountable until the goals are met.

highlights: Developed a Product Pivot strategy in response to changing technology and market trends, and led the transition from a 3D product to a generative AI web platform, officially launched in July 2026.

Implemented LLM-to-Unreal E2E integration for a LangChain-based Film Agent. After the web product launched, took responsibility for planning and developing context management across an entire production.

Personally prototyped and validated technical demos addressing Post Production challenges in generative AI workflows, then handed them over to the development team, which integrated them into the product.
Supported six user studies and two additional model integrations over five months using an internally built motion evaluation platform.

Formed the web team’s AI Literacy TF and redesigned the core user flow. Following a two-week implementation by the web team, production A/B testing confirmed that the clip-download conversion rate reached 2.8 times the baseline.
Planned and launched a Long→Short-form AI editor and a shopping assistant chatbot from 0→1.
Established the product, pricing, contracting, and operational foundations for AIaaS, leading business-wide MRR growth from KRW 5M to KRW 52M in one year.
Led technical discussions, PoCs, and contract negotiations after initial meetings, securing 12 new clients.
Built and led the AIaaS organization from 0 to 20 people, taking responsibility for overall OKRs and for hiring, personnel management, and performance reviews for four PMs.
Used LLMs to automate manual work in developing HR competency assessment tasks, and improved operations to support the turnaround of a family business.
Developed initial product plans and PRDs for HER2 and ER/PR biomarker analysis products, and helped prepare FDA and CE documentation for existing products.
